notes:
- New: Brawl and Commander are separate formats. Brawl uses MTG Arena's card pool and Brawl ban list (Emrakul, the Aeons Torn is legal again); Commander keeps the Commander ban list and plays at 40 life with commander damage. A Brawl deck with cards that aren't on Arena has to be switched to Commander.
- New: Bot Play and Casual Play queues for both Brawl and Commander, in the main menu's EDH tab (formerly Brawl).
- New: 40-card direct challenges with friends (the "40-Card Deck" type).
- New: Archenemy: Sparky takes a Brawl or a Commander deck.
- Fix: Xantcha, Sleeper Agent and other "any player may activate" abilities can be activated when your opponent controls them.
- Fix: Victory Chimes and other "a player of your choice" effects let you pick the player.
- Fix: you're asked whether to exert a creature as it attacks.
- Fix: Vision Charm, Funeral Charm and other modal cards Arena doesn't know show their modes as buttons; Vision Charm asks for both land types.
- Fix: Pandemonium: the entering creature's controller picks the target.
- Fix: a planeswalker's -X (Chandra, Chill of Compliance) and other X costs that aren't mana ask you for X.
- Fix: X can't go higher than the number of legal targets when X sets how many targets you need (Indomitable Creativity), which could leave the game stuck.
- Fix: Deadly Cover-Up can pick the creature that just died.
- Fix: the back faces of modal double-faced cards can be played.
- Fix: win pips stay lit through a best-of-three match.
